status: Proposed training/routing design; no adapter trained or inference routing measured.
recommendation: One generalist plus three overlapping capability specialists; four adapter directories in deployment.
scope: 129 tasks are a public capability profile and development reference, not an automatically authorized new training dataset. No official hidden or reserved evaluation items used.

G.name: 通用仓库修复
G.role: 覆盖全部机制，负责规格恢复、定位、路由不确定任务及跨机制的新功能/重构。不是仅用M1/M8训练的剩余类别。

S.name: 数据表示与结构算法
S.role: 转换前后语义、基数、字节/字符/cell坐标、文本样式跨度，以及扫描/遍历/切分不变量。

F.name: 跨层流转与状态生命周期
F.role: 生产者到消费者的参数/配置/元数据传播，覆盖优先级、共享对象、缓存、所有权、异步资源退出。

R.name: Python动态语义与依赖兼容
R.role: 真实callable/类型/命名空间解析、代理对象协议、MRO和Python/第三方依赖版本语义。

training_design.shared_initialization: Use the same official model family and common eligible repair-process curriculum. Initialize G directly as r128 on text q/o+MLP. Train a separate common r32 all-seven-text-projection starting adapter and copy its complete state into S/F/R before specialization. G and the specialists do not directly share LoRA weight shapes. Each final branch is one complete adapter.
training_design.specialist_mixture_start: Provisional 70% specialty + 30% broad repair-process supervised tokens; not a measured optimum. Unique tasks/repositories and supervised-token counts reported separately.
training_design.common_data_for_all: Navigation, input/output contract, evidence-based edits, necessary manual validation, patch delivery.
training_design.data_policy: Use additional eligible tasks across repositories to provide specialty volume; do not infer training quantity from 129 public tasks or treat duplicate trajectories as independent tasks.
training_design.rank_transfer: No implicit r32-to-r128 padding, r128-to-r32 truncation, or cross-target weight copying. Any later explicit transfer would need separate scaling and behavior verification.

routing_design.available_inputs: Problem statement and observations from current base snapshot only.
routing_design.controller: G with the same official 31B base variant as S/F/R; separate declarative agent configurations bind each adapter.
routing_design.default: G continues when evidence is unclear; choose one main specialist when a concrete mechanism is established.
routing_design.composition: One adapter per agent request; sequential delegation does not add or merge multiple LoRA weights.
routing_design.measure: Compare G against the system using actual routing; gold mechanism selection is only an upper-bound diagnostic.

pure_specialists_alternative.status: Alternative if four disjoint specialists are specifically desired; less robust for unknown tasks.
pure_specialists_alternative.limitation: Remaining D is heterogeneous and has 16 public examples; this alone is not adequate evidence for its training volume or specialization benefit.
